dict.string: Log Meal to Health. Reads a meal nutrition payload (passed in or from the Clipboard), lets you review and edit it, asks for the meal date and time, then logs each provided nutrient as a Nutrition sample in Apple Health and shows a summary notification. Health logging requires iOS or iPadOS. ALLOW_MANUAL_UNIT_CONVERSION: each nutrient is logged in its fixed HealthKit unit (kcal, g, mg, mcg, mL); no Convert Measurement is needed because the values are already in the unit Apple Health expects.

Shortcuts generated by Shortcuts Playground. May contain mistakes. Always check the shortcut's actions first.
This shortcut was created via the following user prompt:
> Build an iOS Shortcut named "Log Meal to Health" that logs meal nutrition into Apple Health from a text payload. Accept text input (fall back to Clipboard), confirm/edit, ask for the date, parse newline key: value lines, and log 39 nutrient types each guarded by an If so only provided numeric values are logged. Show a summary notification.
- Input uses the shortcut's text input; Payload is set to that text. - The next If reads the Clipboard only when the input was empty.
- Condition checks whether Payload has no value (the input was empty). - If empty, read the Clipboard and set Payload to it.
- Condition checks whether Payload still has no value after trying input and Clipboard. - If empty, show an alert and stop the shortcut.
No meal data found. Run this with a payload from Claude (passed in or copied to the clipboard).
- Provided Input shows the Payload so you can review or edit the meal data before logging. - The edited answer is stored as Edited.

- Match Text finds the date line in Edited and Get Group takes its value. - If the value is a real date it is used as the default; the word now, a missing date, or an unparseable value falls back to the Current Date. - Ask for Input (Date) lets you confirm the meal date and time, stored as logDate.
- Condition checks whether a real date was found in the payload. - If yes, default the date picker to that date; otherwise default to the Current Date.
- Match Text finds the name line in Edited and Get Group takes its value. - If a name is present it is stored as mealName; otherwise mealName is set to Meal logged.
- Condition checks whether a meal name was found in the payload. - If yes, store it as mealName; otherwise use Meal logged.
- loggedCount starts at 0 and is increased by 1 each time a nutrient is logged. - The summary notification at the end reports this count under the meal name.
--- LOG NUTRIENTS (39 guarded Log Health Sample actions) ---
